macros.name: LogClose
macros.doc: You can explicitly close a log file if you want to reread it in the course of processing, or call an executable that would process it.

macros.name: SaveValueFile
macros.doc: This gets one argument specifying which file name to use for saving results.

envs.name: ExpectCallSequence
envs.doc: The environment ExpectCallSequence tells the test system that macros are going to be called in a certain order and with particular types of arguments.
